briefing: Field Report from Agent Polaris: Multiple cases of Medicaid and autism fraud have been uncovered in Minnesota, with a large-scale investigation ongoing. The Feeding Our Future case has resulted in over 41 years in prison for the founder, and new charges have been announced in other cases. Aimee Bock, founder of Minnesota Charity Fed Kids, has been charged with Medicaid fraud. The use of shell companies and other financial schemes have been identified as possible means of perpetrating these crimes. The investigation is ongoing, with multiple agencies involved, including the DOJ and HHS. The total alleged amount in these cases exceeds $9.5B+, with 72 people charged and 30 convicted so far.
